name: Standing Mark
description: Independent examination of claims and proposed agent actions, operated by Wheeler Hubbell Publishing, Inc. Returns signed results (WHP-STANDING-MARK-v1, Ed25519) stating what is established and what is not. Does not execute, authorize, pay or settle.

skills.name: Read the live contract
skills.description: GET /v1/contract: routes, payment terms, determinism rule, signed type, issuer key reference. Free.

skills.name: Request an examination
skills.description: POST /v1/evaluate with a claim or proposed action. Unpaid requests return HTTP 402 with a USDC-on-Base quote bound to the exact request bytes (scheme WHP-BASE-USDC-FLAT-1, exactly 1.00 USDC, not x402-exact). Paying the quoted amount and retrying with X-WHP-Quote and X-WHP-Payment-Tx returns the signed examination result.

skills.name: Verify a signed result
skills.description: POST /v1/verification checks a signature (signature only). Independent offline verification against the published issuer key is available in the public developer assets.

x-note: This card describes the HTTP interface for A2A-capable agents. The service does not yet speak the A2A protocol natively; this card is an interoperability description, not a native A2A endpoint.
